findings.evidence: The comments immediately preceding these annotations explicitly justify exposure by unfolding for subsequent lemmas. Existing characteristic lemmas include dualEquiv_functor/inverse/unitIso and totalSpaceEquiv_functor/inverse; the restricted equivalence additionally needs functor-level identifications to avoid unfolding its lifts.
findings.fix: Remove these four @[expose] annotations; provide functor/object identification lemmas and state dependent map, unit, and counit equations using those identifications or explicit transports.
findings.issue: The new linearSpecFiniteLocallyFreeEquiv, totalSpace (line 198), totalSpaceEquiv (line 250), and Dual/Bidual.lean's dualEquiv (line 120) expose their construction, making downstream typing depend on implementation details.

summary: Four new definitions expose implementation bodies to support API statements that rely on definitional equality. Replace that dependency with characteristic lemmas and keep the bodies hidden.
